verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs say it manages secrets and configuration in a unified workflow, offers centralized secrets, documents config and secrets as core concepts, and ships ESC, which can act as an OIDC provider. All of these are high-level mentions, with nothing on how secrets stay out of code, state or logs. Missing for 10: documentation of encrypted secret config values, masking of secrets in CLI/log output, an explanation of how ESC injects secrets into deployments, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
